CustomField.description: Queue ID to fallback to if User ID is inactive
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The 15 character (case sensitive) ID of the Queue used for the fallback (if user is inactive) associated with this Assignment Rule.This ID is shown immediately after "....salesforce.com/p/own/Queue/d?id=" in the URL when viewing the Queue.
CustomField.label: Fallback Queue Id
